sql: SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country != 'Germany'
SELECT SUM(amount)/COUNT(customerNumber) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate >= '2004-01-01' AND paymentDate < '2004-07-01'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.reportsTo FROM customers T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T2.employeeNumber WHERE T1.country='France'
SELECT T3.addressLine1, T3.addressLine2 FROM customers T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T2.employeeNumber JOIN offices T3 ON T2.officeCode=T3.officeCode WHERE T1.city='NYC'
SELECT SUM(T2.quantityOrdered), AVG(T2.priceEach) FROM products T1 JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T1.productName='18th Century Vintage Horse Carriage'
SELECT T1.amount FROM payments T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T2.customerName='Petit Auto' AND T1.paymentDate='2004-08-09'
SELECT T1.addressLine1, T1.addressLine2 FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T2.orderNumber=10383
SELECT T2.email FROM customers T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T2.employeeNumber WHERE T1.customerName='Dragon Souveniers, Ltd.'
SELECT (T1.MSRP - T2.priceEach)/T1.MSRP FROM products T1 JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T2.productCode='S18_3482' AND T2.orderNumber=10108
SELECT T1.customerName FROM customers T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T2.employeeNumber WHERE T2.firstName='Steve' AND T2.lastName='Patterson'
SELECT T2.addressLine1, T2.addressLine2 FROM employees T1 JOIN offices T2 ON T1.officeCode=T2.officeCode WHERE T1.jobTitle='President'

SELECT T3.productName FROM customers T0 JOIN orders T1 ON T0.customerNumber=T1.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.orderNumber=T2.orderNumber JOIN products T3 ON T2.productCode=T3.productCode WHERE T0.customerName='Cruz & Sons Co.' AND T1.orderDate='2003-03-03'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.shippedDate FROM customers T0 JOIN orders T1 ON T0.customerNumber=T1.customerNumber WHERE T0.customerName='Cruz & Sons Co.' AND T1.orderDate='2003-03-03'
SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.quantityOrdered) AS REAL)/12 FROM orderdetails T2 JOIN products T3 ON T2.productCode=T3.productCode WHERE T3.productName='1957 Chevy Pickup'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM orders T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber JOIN employees T3 ON T2.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T3.employeeNumber WHERE T1.status='Disputed'
SELECT T1.productName FROM products T1 JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode ORDER BY T2.priceEach DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT contactFirstName, contactLastName FROM customers WHERE salesRepEmployeeNumber=1370 ORDER BY creditLimit DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T3.productName, SUM(T2.quantityOrdered) FROM orders T1 JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.orderNumber=T2.orderNumber JOIN products T3 ON T2.productCode=T3.productCode WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',T1.orderDate)='2003' GROUP BY T3.productName ORDER BY SUM(T2.quantityOrdered) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT DISTINCT T2.customerName FROM orders T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.status='Disputed'
